user_saw: Nothing visible to users was reported, but the Gateway post-ready test failed with a syntax error when its helper ran under Node 20.
summary: The fix applies OpenClaw’s Node version check to both the current executable and each probed candidate, so helper processes skip unsupported Node installations.
reasoning: The original resolver and its pre-fix SDK documentation promised a real Node executable with any requested flag, which was enough for the original inline tool-code child. PR #176851 added a Gateway test caller that used the same resolver to launch a helper importing compiled OpenClaw code. In the reported mixed-PATH reproduction, the resolver selected Node 20 ahead of Node 24, and Node 20 could not parse the compiled module’s `using` declaration.
